scope.included_material: Completed producer command_execution events, their fixed review-extract indexes/hashes, the interrupted prelude-proposals business extract, and applicable AGENTS snapshots.

steps: Enumerated every completed command_execution in each fixed producer phase.

Verified each standard review-extract event_line/native_item_id/exit_code/command SHA-256/output SHA-256 against the corresponding events JSONL; verified events hashes against review extracts and sealed records.
Verified the interrupted SIGKILL phase against its fixed business extract and interruption record because no normal sealed review extract exists.

Screened command text for parent repository tests, implementation, original design, development ledger, examples/adapters, sibling control/operator, parent traversal and host-policy paths; opened only matching completed command_execution outputs where classification required it.
Applied the AGENTS version evidenced for the command phase, not the current file. Same-phase prior cat evidence is distinguished from phase-end or bracketing snapshot evidence.

classification_rules.actual_read_or_search: A completed cat/sed/rg/awk/etc. invocation against an out-of-scope path counts as an executed read/search even when rg returns no match or a compound command exits nonzero after returning some matches.
classification_rules.help: AWR --help and installed binary execution do not count as parent source reads.
classification_rules.output_only: A path appearing only in AWR output, a README link, a hash input string, or a project-local receipt does not prove a second filesystem read.
classification_rules.host_quick_pass: Reads of RTK, installed skills and memory registry are listed separately because local AGENTS defers to higher-priority host instructions; they are not silently folded into project public-reference compliance.
classification_rules.no_pollution_inference: No later absence of contamination is used to retroactively approve an original out-of-scope read/search.

overall.verdict: Four of five reviewed runs contain confirmed producer commands that searched or read beyond the phase-bound public technical entry points. Two of those four have direct same-phase prior AGENTS reads; two rely on phase-end or bracketing AGENTS snapshots and retain that temporal limitation. This report records the gap and makes no count/status change.

limitations: The audit is command-scope only and does not decide whether returned technical material changed business outputs.
Private native reasoning/system/context was deliberately not read.

For long-task-resume and interrupted-write, the command is directly proven but the applicable AGENTS content is bound by phase-end or bracketing snapshots rather than a prior public cat receipt; this temporal proof limit is retained in their verdicts.
Commands or reads absent from the fixed events cannot be inferred. No missing data is fabricated.
